title: Gaze2HOI: Gaze-Aware Intention Disambiguation for Egocentric Hand-Object Interaction Forecasting
title_zh: Gaze2HOI：基于视线感知的自我视角手物交互预测中的意图消歧方法

paragraphs.en: 该文提出Gaze2HOI框架，利用视线线索在自我视角手物交互预测中进行意图消歧，并结合扩散模型生成手物运动，性能达到业界领先。 Anticipating how users will interact with their surroundings is essential for proactive systems that provide timely assistance in AR, VR, and embodied applications. Prior work typically forecasts hand-object interactions directly from historical observations, leaving intention and contact geometry implicit. However, similar observation histories can precede semantically or geometrically distinct futures. Inspired by behavioral evidence that gaze can provide early cues for underlying intention, we propose Gaze2HOI, a gaze-aware framework that formulates hand-object interaction forecasting as a hierarchical problem comprising intention inference, contact grounding, and coupled hand-object motion generation. Specifically, Gaze2HOI first weights gaze cues by fixation strength and recency, and uses them to modulate the visual representations of a vision-language model (VLM) through Temporal Gaze Saliency Modulation (TGSM), thereby reducing semantic ambiguity in intention inference. Subsequently, an Anticipatory Contact Grounding (ACG) module maps these structured intentions into explicit contact, support, and placement fields, effectively mitigating geometric ambiguity. Driven by these explicit conditions, a diffusion-based model jointly generates the 6-DoF object trajectories and future articulated motion of both hands. To evaluate Gaze2HOI, we further introduce EgoAIM, a phase-aware benchmark that organizes egocentric hand-object interactions into four phases defined by evolving hand-object relations and provides fine-grained intention annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Gaze2HOI achieves state-of-the-art performance in both intention inference and motion forecasting, even approaching oracle-level end-to-end performance in specific interaction phases. Project page: https://gaze2hoi.github.io/.
paragraphs.zh: 该文提出Gaze2HOI框架，利用视线线索在自我视角手物交互预测中进行意图消歧，并结合扩散模型生成手物运动，性能达到业界领先。预测用户将如何与周围环境互动，对于在AR、VR和具身应用中提供及时辅助的主动式系统至关重要。 以往的工作通常直接从历史观测预测手物交互，将意图和接触几何隐含地留在模型之中。 然而，相似的观测历史可能对应语义或几何上截然不同的未来。 受行为学证据的启发——视线能够为潜在意图提供早期线索——我们提出Gaze2HOI，这是一个视线感知框架，将手物交互预测表述为一个分层问题，包括意图推断、接触定位和耦合的手物运动生成。 具体而言，Gaze2HOI首先根据注视强度和时近性对视线线索进行加权，并通过时间视线显著性调制（TGSM）利用这些线索来调节视觉语言模型（VLM）的视觉表征，从而减少意图推断中的语义歧义。 随后，一个预期性接触定位（ACG）模块将这些结构化的意图映射为显式的接触场、支撑场和放置场，有效缓解几何歧义。 在这些显式条件的驱动下，一个基于扩散的模型联合生成物体的6自由度轨迹以及双手未来的关节运动。 为了评估Gaze2HOI，我们进一步提出EgoAIM，这是一个阶段感知的基准，将自我中心视角的手物交互按照不断演化的手物关系划分为四个阶段，并提供细粒度的意图标注。 大量实验表明，Gaze2HOI在意图推断和运动预测两方面均取得了最先进的性能，在特定交互阶段甚至接近oracle级的端到端性能。 项目页面：https://gaze2hoi.github.io/。
